items.title: JLPT N5
items.description:
Beginner-level Japanese covering basic grammar, hiragana/katakana, and everyday conversation. Ideal for first-time learners.

Duration: 3 months — Rs. 12,000

items.title: JLPT N4
items.description:
Builds on N5 with expanded grammar, kanji, and listening practice, preparing students for entry-level workplace communication.

Duration: 4 months — Rs. 15,000

items.title: JFT-Basic
items.description:
Focused preparation for the Japan Foundation Test for Basic Japanese, required for most SSW visa categories.

Duration: 3 months — Rs. 13,000
